# ORBITEGO Website Development

## Project Overview
Building a professional HTML/CSS/JavaScript website for ORBITEGO - a premier East African marketing, strategic branding, and digital growth agency.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Home page with hero section and services overview
- `pages/` - Sub-pages (about, services, portfolio, blog, contact)
- `assets/css/` - Styling files
- `assets/js/` - JavaScript functionality
- `assets/images/` - Images and media placeholders

## Key Pages
1. Home - Hero section, services overview, statistics, CTA
2. About Us - Company vision, mission, core values
3. Services - Detailed service offerings (5 core pillars + extended toolkit)
4. Portfolio - Case studies and work examples
5. Blog - Industry insights and content
6. Contact - Contact form and office details

## Development Guidelines
- Responsive design (mobile-first approach)
- Modern, professional styling similar to WebbingStone
- Smooth scrolling and interactions
- Fast loading performance
- Accessible HTML structure

## Deployment Ready
The website is built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS for easy deployment to any web server.
